exclusions.source_text: Women 18 years or older at the time of informed consent
Confirmed Corrected QT Interval by Fridericia (QTcF) > 470 ms on screening ECG
history of torsades de pointes (TdP), or history of congenital long QT syndrome
Any other clinically important abnormalities in rhythm, conduction, or morphology on resting ECG
Congestive heart failure Grades II-IV according to the New York Heart Association at the time of screening
Myocardial infarction or unstable angina within the previous 6 months
